data.text: Luke, your plan keeps the stock full, but I’d rather negotiate for more than $9,000. John, would you support 13 tons each for you and me, with Luke, Kate, and Jack taking 8 each? That totals 50, leaving 50 to replenish the lake to 100. You and I would each earn $13,000 this month. It requires the others to accept less, so this is a proposal—not an agreement. John, does that allocation work for you?
